meta.provenance: every fine in this bundle carries a source_url

HWY_LANE_INDICATOR.name: Failure to use turn-indicator on expressway
keywords: failure to use turn-indicator on expressway

HWY_STOP_ON_SHOULDER.name: Stopping on highway shoulder / express lane
keywords: stopping on highway shoulder / express lane
HWY_STOP_ON_SHOULDER.tips_to_avoid: Keep emergency kit: triangle, torch, jack, spare tube/tyre.
HWY_STOP_ON_SHOULDER.what_to_do_next: Move on at once unless breakdown — then switch hazard lights + reflective triangle 15m behind.

HWY_MIN_SPEED_VIOLATION.name: Driving below minimum prescribed speed (expressway)
HWY_MIN_SPEED_VIOLATION.what_to_do_next: Speed up to prescribed minimum (usually 60 kph) or exit expressway.

HWY_REVERSING_HIGHWAY.name: Reversing on highway / expressway
HWY_REVERSING_HIGHWAY.what_to_do_next: Extremely dangerous. Drive to next U-turn / exit.

HWY_TRUCK_LEFT_LANE.name: Truck not using leftmost lane on expressway
keywords: truck not using leftmost lane on expressway

OVERLOAD_ROOFTOP_LUGGAGE.name: Unsecured rooftop / extra luggage beyond limits
keywords: unsecured rooftop / extra luggage beyond limits

OVERLOAD_GOODS_WEIGHT.name: Overloading a goods vehicle by weight
keywords: overloading a goods vehicle by weight
OVERLOAD_GOODS_WEIGHT.what_to_do_next: Off-load excess at nearest weigh station. Pay ₹20,000 + ₹2,000 per extra tonne.

OVERLOAD_PASSENGER.name: Overloading of passenger vehicle
OVERLOAD_PASSENGER.what_to_do_next: Drop extra passengers; ₹200 per extra passenger.

PARK_DISABLED_SPOT.name: Parking in disabled-reserved spot without permit
keywords: parking in disabled-reserved spot without permit
PARK_DISABLED_SPOT.what_to_do_next: Vacate immediately. Only disabled-permit holders may park.

PARK_FIRE_HYDRANT.name: Parking blocking fire hydrant / emergency access
keywords: parking blocking fire hydrant / emergency access
PARK_FIRE_HYDRANT.what_to_do_next: Move at once. Fine ₹500–1,000; vehicle may be forcibly removed in emergency.

PARK_ABANDONED.name: Abandoned vehicle on road
PARK_ABANDONED.what_to_do_next: Claim vehicle at nearest police station within 30 days or it will be auctioned.

PARK_NO_PARKING.name: Parking in no-parking zone
PARK_NO_PARKING.what_to_do_next: Move vehicle immediately; pay ₹500 first-time, ₹1,000 repeat + towing ₹500–1,500.

PARK_NIGHT_NO_LIGHTS.name: Parked vehicle without parking lights at night
keywords: parked vehicle without parking lights at night

PARK_FOOTPATH.name: Parking on footpath / pedestrian area
PARK_FOOTPATH.what_to_do_next: Pedestrians have absolute right of way. Pay ₹500–1,000.

PARK_BUS_STOP.name: Parking at bus stop / taxi stand
keywords: parking at bus stop / taxi stand

PARK_DOUBLE_PARKING.name: Double parking / parking away from kerb
keywords: double parking / parking away from kerb
PARK_DOUBLE_PARKING.what_to_do_next: Park parallel to kerb within 30 cm. Move now.

PARK_EV_SPOT_MISUSE.name: Non-EV parked in EV-reserved charging spot
keywords: non-ev parked in ev-reserved charging spot

EV_UNREG_RETROFIT.name: Unauthorised ICE→EV retrofit without RTO approval
keywords: unauthorised ice→ev retrofit without rto approval
EV_UNREG_RETROFIT.what_to_do_next: Stop plying. Retrofit kit must be ARAI / ICAT certified; RTO re-registration mandatory.

EV_FIRE_BATTERY_NONCOMPLIANT.name: Use of non-AIS-156 compliant EV battery
keywords: use of non-ais-156 compliant ev battery

EV_CHARGING_UNAUTH.name: Charging EV at unauthorised / domestic outlet in public place
keywords: charging ev at unauthorised / domestic outlet in public place
EV_CHARGING_UNAUTH.tips_to_avoid: App-find chargers — PlugShare, Tata Power EZ Charge, Ather Grid.
EV_CHARGING_UNAUTH.what_to_do_next: Charge only at authorised public stations (Bharat EV / BECIL network).

EV_RESTRICTED_ZONE_VIOLATION.name: Low-speed EV in restricted zone (e.g., highway)
keywords: low-speed ev in restricted zone (e.g., highway)

DIR_WRONG_WAY.name: Driving on wrong side / opposite lane
keywords: driving on wrong side / opposite lane
DIR_WRONG_WAY.tips_to_avoid: Follow divider colour: yellow on your right = correct side.
DIR_WRONG_WAY.what_to_do_next: Stop, turn around safely at next opening. Pay ₹1,500 first-time, ₹5,000 repeat.

DIR_FAIL_TO_YIELD.name: Failure to yield right of way
keywords: failure to yield right of way

DIR_ILLEGAL_OVERTAKING.name: Overtaking from wrong side / in no-overtaking zone
keywords: overtaking from wrong side / in no-overtaking zone
DIR_ILLEGAL_OVERTAKING.tips_to_avoid: Overtake only on right side of slower vehicle; never on bridges, curves, or near oncoming traffic.

DIR_LANE_DISCIPLINE.name: Lane indiscipline / failing to keep to prescribed lane
keywords: lane indiscipline / failing to keep to prescribed lane
DIR_LANE_DISCIPLINE.what_to_do_next: Stay in assigned lane; use indicator before changing.

DIR_BUS_TAXI_LANE.name: Using dedicated bus/taxi lane in violation
keywords: using dedicated bus/taxi lane in violation

DIR_NO_ENTRY.name: Entering a no-entry zone
DIR_NO_ENTRY.what_to_do_next: Back out or find approved detour; pay ₹500–1,000.

DIR_NO_UTURN.name: Taking a U-turn where prohibited
DIR_NO_UTURN.what_to_do_next: Take the next approved U-turn; pay ₹500–1,000.

DIR_ONE_WAY_VIOLATION.name: Entering one-way road from wrong direction
keywords: entering one-way road from wrong direction

SAFETY_NO_HELMET_PILLION.name: Pillion rider not wearing helmet
SAFETY_NO_HELMET_PILLION.what_to_do_next: Pillion must wear an ISI helmet; fine ₹1,000.

SAFETY_NO_CHILD_RESTRAINT.name: Child under 14 without helmet / child-restraint
SAFETY_NO_CHILD_RESTRAINT.tips_to_avoid: 0–1 yr: rear-facing; 1–4 yrs: forward-facing; 4–12 yrs: booster + belt.
SAFETY_NO_CHILD_RESTRAINT.what_to_do_next: Install ISOFIX / age-appropriate child seat (CMVR 138A since 2023). Fine ₹1,000.

SAFETY_NO_CHILD_2W.name: Carrying child below 4 on 2W without safety harness + helmet
keywords: carrying child below 4 on 2w without safety harness + helmet
SAFETY_NO_CHILD_2W.what_to_do_next: Child < 4 yrs: must wear crash helmet + be tethered with safety harness. Max speed 40 kph.

SAFETY_NO_SEATBELT_PASSENGER.name: Passenger (incl. rear) not wearing seat belt
keywords: passenger (incl. rear) not wearing seat belt
SAFETY_NO_SEATBELT_PASSENGER.what_to_do_next: All passengers including rear must wear seat belts (post-2022 enforcement). Pay ₹1,000 per passenger.

SAFETY_NO_HELMET_RIDER.name: Rider not wearing helmet
SAFETY_NO_HELMET_RIDER.tips_to_avoid: Helmet must be buckled; 'half helmets' / construction helmets are NOT legal.
SAFETY_NO_HELMET_RIDER.what_to_do_next: Put on an ISI-marked helmet (IS 4151). Pay ₹1,000; DL may be suspended 3 months.
SAFETY_NO_HELMET_RIDER.common_misconception: Pillion rider also needs a helmet — not just the main rider.

SAFETY_NO_AIRBAG.name: Selling / operating new LMV without dual front airbags
keywords: selling / operating new lmv without dual front airbags

SAFETY_NO_SEATBELT_DRIVER.name: Driver not wearing seat belt
SAFETY_NO_SEATBELT_DRIVER.tips_to_avoid: Seat belts save ~45% of lives in front-seat crashes (WHO).

SAFETY_MORE_THAN_2_ON_2W.name: More than 2 persons on a two-wheeler (triple riding)
keywords: more than 2 persons on a two-wheeler (triple riding)
SAFETY_MORE_THAN_2_ON_2W.what_to_do_next: Drop the extra rider. Only 2 permitted. Fine ₹1,000.

PED_ZEBRA_VIOLATION.name: Not giving way to pedestrian at zebra crossing
keywords: not giving way to pedestrian at zebra crossing

PARK_ZEBRA_CROSSING.name: Stopping on zebra crossing / pedestrian crossing
keywords: stopping on zebra crossing / pedestrian crossing

CYCLIST_DOORING.name: Opening door unsafely into cyclist / vehicle path
keywords: opening door unsafely into cyclist / vehicle path

DIST_HEADPHONES.name: Driving while wearing headphones / both ears covered
keywords: driving while wearing headphones / both ears covered
DIST_HEADPHONES.what_to_do_next: Remove headphones; single-ear Bluetooth okay in some states.

DIST_MOBILE_USE.name: Using mobile phone while driving
DIST_MOBILE_USE.tips_to_avoid: Hands-free / voice navigation permitted. Use dashboard mount + Bluetooth.
DIST_MOBILE_USE.what_to_do_next: Pull over safely to use phone. Pay ₹5,000 (1st) / ₹10,000 (repeat).
DIST_MOBILE_USE.common_misconception: Even at a red signal, phone use counts as the vehicle is still 'in use'.

IMPAIRED_DRUGS.name: Driving under influence of drugs
IMPAIRED_DRUGS.consequence: Same as drunk driving + possible NDPS proceedings.

IMPAIRED_REFUSE_TEST.name: Refusing breath / blood test
IMPAIRED_REFUSE_TEST.what_to_do_next: Refusal itself is an offence — presumption of guilt.

IMPAIRED_DRUNK.name: Drunk driving (BAC > 30 mg/100 ml blood)
IMPAIRED_DRUNK.tips_to_avoid: Permissible BAC 30 mg/100 ml (~half pint of beer for most adults). Zero BAC required for commercial drivers in many states.
IMPAIRED_DRUNK.what_to_do_next: Cooperate with breathalyser. Do not drive. Call a cab / sober friend.
IMPAIRED_DRUNK.consequence: Fine ₹10,000 + 6 months jail (1st); ₹15,000 + 2 yrs jail (repeat within 3 yrs).

FASTAG_TAMPERED.name: Use of tampered / duplicate FASTag
FASTAG_TAMPERED.what_to_do_next: Blacklist reported; fine ₹5,000–10,000. Re-apply with correct KYC.

COMM_AGGREGATOR_NO_LICENCE.name: Aggregator operating without state licence
COMM_AGGREGATOR_NO_LICENCE.what_to_do_next: Aggregator must apply for licence under MV Aggregator Rules 2020. ₹25k–₹1L fine per case.

FASTAG_MULTI_VEHICLE.name: Same FASTag used across multiple vehicles
keywords: same fastag used across multiple vehicles

SCHOOL_BUS_GPS_CAMERA.name: School bus lacking CCTV + GPS + lady attendant
keywords: school bus lacking cctv + gps + lady attendant
SCHOOL_BUS_GPS_CAMERA.what_to_do_next: Immediately comply: install VLT/GPS, CCTV, yellow livery, female attendant.

COMM_NO_GPS_VLTS.name: Commercial vehicle without GPS / VLTS (where mandated)
keywords: commercial vehicle without gps / vlts (where mandated)

COMM_NO_FARE_METER.name: Taxi / auto without calibrated fare meter
keywords: taxi / auto without calibrated fare meter
COMM_NO_FARE_METER.what_to_do_next: Install calibrated meter; get it re-stamped at Legal Metrology.

COMM_REFUSAL.name: Refusal of hire by auto / taxi
keywords: refusal of hire by auto / taxi
COMM_REFUSAL.what_to_do_next: Record complaint at https://transport.<state>.gov.in. Fine up to ₹500.

TOLL_EVASION.name: Toll evasion (breaking barrier / forced lane change)
keywords: toll evasion (breaking barrier / forced lane change)
TOLL_EVASION.what_to_do_next: Pay toll + ₹5,000 penalty; repeat — FIR under BNS for criminal breach.

FASTAG_NONE.name: No FASTag on National Highway toll plaza
keywords: no fastag on national highway toll plaza
FASTAG_NONE.tips_to_avoid: FASTag is mandatory since 15-Feb-2021 on all NH / SH toll plazas.
FASTAG_NONE.what_to_do_next: Pay 2x user fee at toll; buy FASTag at on-site counter or online (Paytm / HDFC / SBI).

COMM_NO_PERMIT.name: Plying commercial vehicle without permit
COMM_NO_PERMIT.what_to_do_next: Park vehicle. Apply for permit at RTO; ₹10,000 fine.

ACC_CAUSING_DEATH.name: Causing death by negligent driving
ACC_CAUSING_DEATH.what_to_do_next: Cooperate; legal counsel; victim's family entitled to ₹2L solatium (Sec 161).
ACC_CAUSING_DEATH.consequence: BNS Sec 106 — up to 5 yrs jail + fine.

EMERG_NO_WAY_TO_AMBULANCE.name: Not making way for emergency vehicle (ambulance / fire)
keywords: not making way for emergency vehicle (ambulance / fire)

ACC_NOT_REPORT.name: Not reporting accident within 24 hours
ACC_NOT_REPORT.what_to_do_next: Report at nearest PS within 24 hrs; collect DAR.

ACC_HIT_AND_RUN.name: Leaving the scene of an accident (hit-and-run)
keywords: leaving the scene of an accident (hit-and-run)
ACC_HIT_AND_RUN.tips_to_avoid: Stop, call 112, help injured (Good Samaritan Law protects helpers from harassment).
ACC_HIT_AND_RUN.what_to_do_next: Non-compoundable. Report to police within 24 hours under Sec 134.
ACC_HIT_AND_RUN.consequence: BNS Sec 106(2): up to 10 yrs jail for fatal hit-and-run (effective July 2024).

DOC_UNDERAGE.name: Underage driving
DOC_UNDERAGE.tips_to_avoid: Minimum ages: 16 yrs (gearless ≤50cc), 18 yrs (geared motorcycle & LMV), 20 yrs (transport).
DOC_UNDERAGE.what_to_do_next: The juvenile must stop immediately. Guardian will receive summons. Vehicle registration will be cancelled for 12 months.
DOC_UNDERAGE.common_misconception: Letting a minor 'learn' on a vacant road is still an offence if the vehicle is on a public place.

SPEED_OVER_MMV_HMV.name: Over-speeding (medium/heavy vehicle)
SPEED_OVER_MMV_HMV.tips_to_avoid: HMV national default 80 kph (NH), 60 kph (state roads); check speed governor.

SPEED_EXCESSIVE_50PLUS.name: Exceeding speed limit by more than 50%
keywords: exceeding speed limit by more than 50%
SPEED_EXCESSIVE_50PLUS.what_to_do_next: Cooperate — this is an aggravated offence with probable DL suspension.

SPEED_IN_RESIDENTIAL_SCHOOL_ZONE.name: Speeding in school / residential / silence zone
keywords: speeding in school / residential / silence zone
SPEED_IN_RESIDENTIAL_SCHOOL_ZONE.tips_to_avoid: Keep school-hour awareness (07:30–09:30, 13:00–16:00); enforce limit even when no children visible.
SPEED_IN_RESIDENTIAL_SCHOOL_ZONE.what_to_do_next: Reduce to 25–30 kph in school zones. Pay compounded fine.

SPEED_OVER_LMV.name: Over-speeding (LMV / car / 2W / 3W)
SPEED_OVER_LMV.tips_to_avoid: Use cruise control; follow posted signs; city default 50 kph unless signed otherwise.
SPEED_OVER_LMV.what_to_do_next: Slow down to posted limit. Pay ₹1,000–2,000 via e-challan.

MOD_FAKE_NUMBER_PLATE.name: Use of fake / copied number plate
keywords: use of fake / copied number plate

MOD_FANCY_NUMBERPLATE.name: Stylised / fancy / illegible number plate font
keywords: stylised / fancy / illegible number plate font
MOD_FANCY_NUMBERPLATE.what_to_do_next: Replace with standard HSRP in Charlie block font.

SPEED_GOVERNOR_TAMPER.name: Tampering / disabling speed governor on commercial vehicle
keywords: tampering / disabling speed governor on commercial vehicle
SPEED_GOVERNOR_TAMPER.what_to_do_next: Restore speed governor at authorised ASG dealer; obtain seal certificate.

MOD_NO_HEADLIGHT_DRL.name: Two-wheeler AHO (Always Headlight On) disabled post-Apr 2017
keywords: two-wheeler aho (always headlight on) disabled post-apr 2017

MOD_STRUCTURAL.name: Unauthorised structural modification (chassis / engine / colour)
MOD_STRUCTURAL.what_to_do_next: Restore vehicle to factory spec; visit RTO for re-inspection.
MOD_STRUCTURAL.consequence: Fine ₹5,000–10,000; RC may be cancelled (SC judgment 2019).

MOD_ILLEGAL_LED_HID.name: Use of high-intensity / colour-changing lamps
MOD_ILLEGAL_LED_HID.what_to_do_next: Replace with OEM projector. Fine ₹5,000; lamps seized.

MOD_FOG_LAMP_FRONT_ROOF.name: Auxiliary fog lamps on roof / bull-bar
keywords: auxiliary fog lamps on roof / bull-bar

MOD_TINTED_GLASS.name: Tinted glass below permissible VLT
MOD_TINTED_GLASS.what_to_do_next: Remove tint films. Front/windscreen must allow 70% VLT; sides 50%.

MOD_LASER_JAMMER.name: Installing radar / laser jammer or speed-camera detector
keywords: installing radar / laser jammer or speed-camera detector

MOD_HSRP_MISSING.name: Missing / non-HSRP high-security registration plate
MOD_HSRP_MISSING.what_to_do_next: Book HSRP online at https://bookmyhsrp.com. Installation fee ₹500–1,500.

DOC_FAKE_DL.name: Using fake / tampered driving licence
DOC_FAKE_DL.what_to_do_next: Non-compoundable criminal offence. Cooperate with officer; legal counsel advised.

DOC_DISOBEY_AUTHORITY.name: Disobeying orders of authorities / refusing information
keywords: disobeying orders of authorities / refusing information
DOC_DISOBEY_AUTHORITY.what_to_do_next: Stop when signalled; show documents. Refusing can escalate to a higher offence (Sec 179).

DOC_NO_INSURANCE.name: Driving without vehicle insurance
DOC_NO_INSURANCE.tips_to_avoid: Third-party insurance is mandatory since 1988. Renew annually; insurers now sell long-term 3Y/5Y covers for new vehicles.
DOC_NO_INSURANCE.what_to_do_next: Park vehicle safely. Buy at least 3rd-party motor insurance online (policy instant). Then drive.

DOC_TAKING_VEHICLE_WITHOUT_AUTH.name: Taking a vehicle without owner's authority
keywords: taking a vehicle without owner's authority

DOC_NO_FITNESS.name: Commercial vehicle without fitness certificate
DOC_NO_FITNESS.tips_to_avoid: Plan fitness well in advance; ATS slots fill fast in metros.
DOC_NO_FITNESS.what_to_do_next: Do not ply. Book fitness test at authorised Automated Testing Station (ATS). Commercial vehicles >8 yrs require fitness every year.

DOC_NO_DL.name: Driving without valid driving licence
DOC_NO_DL.tips_to_avoid: Always carry a DL digitally on DigiLocker or mParivahan app — accepted as original.
DOC_NO_DL.what_to_do_next: Stop the vehicle safely. Do not drive further. Arrange a licensed driver or taxi. Apply for a Learner's Licence at https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in before driving again.
DOC_NO_DL.common_misconception: A learner's licence alone is NOT sufficient — a licensed adult must be in the front seat and 'L' plates mandatory.

DOC_DISQUALIFIED_DRIVING.name: Driving while disqualified / DL suspended
DOC_DISQUALIFIED_DRIVING.what_to_do_next: Immediately surrender keys. This is non-compoundable — attend court on summons date.
DOC_DISQUALIFIED_DRIVING.consequence: Imprisonment up to 3 months OR fine up to ₹10,000, or both.

DOC_EXPIRED_RC.name: Driving with expired RC
DOC_EXPIRED_RC.tips_to_avoid: Private vehicle RC valid 15 years; renew before expiry — reminder auto-sent via SMS by RTO.
DOC_EXPIRED_RC.what_to_do_next: Do not drive. Renew within 60 days of expiry via VAHAN 4.0 (Form 25). Late fee ₹300/month.

DOC_NO_RC.name: Driving without registration certificate (RC)
DOC_NO_RC.tips_to_avoid: New vehicles have 30 days from delivery to get permanent registration; do not drive without TR number.
DOC_NO_RC.what_to_do_next: Show RC on mParivahan or DigiLocker (digital = valid). If unregistered, stop driving and apply via VAHAN 4.0.

NOISE_PRESSURE_HORN.name: Use of pressure / multi-toned horn
NOISE_PRESSURE_HORN.tips_to_avoid: Pressure / multi-toned / musical horns banned nationally under CMVR 119.
NOISE_PRESSURE_HORN.what_to_do_next: Replace with factory horn. ₹1,000–2,000 fine; horn seized.

EMIT_POLLUTION_EXCEED.name: Exceeding permissible emission (smoke / CO₂)
EMIT_POLLUTION_EXCEED.what_to_do_next: Get engine tuned; re-test PUC within 7 days.

EMIT_BS_NONCOMPLIANT.name: Non-BS-VI compliant vehicle plying in banned zone
keywords: non-bs-vi compliant vehicle plying in banned zone

DOC_NO_PUC.name: Driving without Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate
keywords: driving without pollution under control (puc) certificate
DOC_NO_PUC.tips_to_avoid: Set a 5-month calendar reminder; keep PUC soft-copy on mParivahan.
DOC_NO_PUC.what_to_do_next: Visit the nearest PUC centre (list on parivahan.gov.in). Test takes 5 minutes; certificate valid 6 months for BS-IV+, 3 months otherwise.

EMIT_OLD_DIESEL_NCR.name: Diesel vehicle >10 years / petrol >15 years plying in NCR/Delhi
keywords: diesel vehicle >10 years / petrol >15 years plying in ncr/delhi
EMIT_OLD_DIESEL_NCR.tips_to_avoid: Diesel 10-yr / petrol 15-yr age rule applicable in NCR only (NGT 2015 order).
EMIT_OLD_DIESEL_NCR.what_to_do_next: Vehicle cannot ply in NCR. Apply for NOC → re-register in another state (if eligible) or scrap via RVSF.

SIGNAL_RED_LIGHT_JUMPING.name: Jumping a red traffic light
SIGNAL_RED_LIGHT_JUMPING.tips_to_avoid: Stop on amber unless already past stop-line; respect all-red phase.

SIGNAL_DISOBEY_POLICE_SIGNAL.name: Disobeying a traffic police signal
SIGNAL_DISOBEY_POLICE_SIGNAL.what_to_do_next: Apologise, cooperate. Fine ₹2,000 first time, up to ₹5,000.

DANGER_RACING.name: Racing / speed-trial on public road
DANGER_RACING.what_to_do_next: Stop racing. Non-compoundable. ₹5,000 fine; 3-month imprisonment possible.

DANGER_STUNT_WHEELIE.name: Stunt riding / wheelie / drifting on public road
keywords: stunt riding / wheelie / drifting on public road

DANGER_UNSAFE_VEHICLE.name: Driving a vehicle in unsafe condition
keywords: driving a vehicle in unsafe condition

DN.name: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

fine:425.imprisonment: up to 6 months (first), up to 2 years (repeat)

fine:427.imprisonment: first: up to 6 months or fine ₹1k–5k; repeat (within 3 yrs): up to 2 years or fine up to ₹10k or both
